item.title: dvisor: a progressive query engine for the browser
item.description:
Renato Campos Mauro, Eduardo Ogasawara, Cláudio Esperança
dvisor (Data Visualization Optimized Retrieval) is a progressive query engine that runs in the browser. It runs SQL queries against remote Parquet files with no backend server, and streams partial results as they arrive. The engine is written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly.

Unlike traditional chatbots, GAI chatbots generate responses dynamically rather than relying on pre-programmed replies, enabling more natural and interactive engagement.
